For I0, with n=2m=(p-1)/3 and 1/3=-n+p/3, proved termwise modulo p^3 the finite terminating deformation (-n+p/3)_k/(-n)_k = 1-(p/3)A_k+(p^2/18)(A_k^2-B_k), where A_k=H_n-H_{n-k} and B_k=H_n^(2)-H_{n-k}^(2).

Combined I0 with the already-persisted I1/I2 carriers to obtain the source-preserving normal form W_p = Uhat_0 + p[v_m-Uhat_1/3+b_1 Q_m] + p^2[Uhat_2/18-v_m A_m/3+b_1 J_m+(4/9)(6/p)K_m] mod p^3, with the stated precision of b_1 Q_m and b_1 J_m preserved.

Executed an exact deterministic regression over all 166 target primes p<5000, 83 in each residue class; termwise deformation, summed I0 identity and isolated k=m formula all pass.
